newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, UK holiday kills trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, UK holiday kills trade.

text.p: NWE oil products opened steady on Monday morning with a public holiday in Britain killing off most chances of trade, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil was untraded in early business, and offered at $81/$82 fob. Initial estimates for the bunker market were of low volumes.
Heating oil barges were also unchanged. Business was hit by the lack of IPE gas oil futures trading. Offers were tentatively assessed at IPE June +$1.50 fob Rotterdam, or at around $179/$179.50.
